name: BOLDSystems_search_by_taxon
description: Search BOLD (Barcode of Life Data System) DNA barcode records by taxon. rank='genus'/'family'/'order' filters server-side; rank='species' (e.g. 'Panthera leo') queries at genus level and filters client-side, since BOLD does not support server-side species filtering. Optionally narrow by country. Example: taxon_name='Panthera', rank='genus' returns all big-cat barcode records with BIN cluster IDs, COI-5P accession numbers, and collection metadata.

taxon_name.description: Taxon name matching rank, e.g. 'Panthera' (genus), 'Felidae' (family), 'Carnivora' (order), or 'Panthera leo' (species).

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of taxon_name. Default 'genus', or 'species' when taxon_name has two words (e.g. 'Apis mellifera').

country.description: Optional country/ocean name to narrow results, e.g. 'Canada'.

class.description: Class, e.g. 'Mammalia'. Note the property name shadows a Python keyword, so it has to be read by subscript.

collection_date_start.description: Start of the collection date, or null where the depositor gave none - measured null on the example record.

collectors.description: Who collected the specimen, e.g. 'Metro Toronto Zoo'. Also reveals a captive or zoo origin, which matters for a record used as a wild-population reference.

identification_rank.description: How deep the identification goes, e.g. 'species', 'genus', 'family'. A record identified only to genus looks the same otherwise, so reading the name without this rank overstates what is known.

inst.description: Institution holding the voucher specimen, e.g. 'Royal Ontario Museum'. Where the physical specimen can be examined.

kingdom.description: Kingdom of the identified taxon, e.g. 'Animalia'.

marker_code.description: The barcode region sequenced, e.g. 'COI-5P', 'ITS', 'matK', 'rbcL'. Sequences from different markers are not comparable, and this is the only field that says which was used.

nuc_basecount.description: Length of the barcode sequence in bases, e.g. 643. A short COI-5P read is a weak barcode; the sequence string alone does not flag that.

sampleid.description: The depositor's own specimen id, e.g. 'ROM PM13004'. What links the record to the physical voucher in the collection.

name: BOLDSystems_search_by_bin
description: Search BOLD (Barcode of Life Data System) for all DNA barcode records sharing a BIN (Barcode Index Number) -- BOLD's algorithmic, sequence-similarity-based species-cluster identifier, which often resolves identity where taxonomy alone cannot. Example: bin_id='BOLD:AAD6819' returns 51 specimen records of Panthera leo sharing that barcode cluster. This is a capability unique to BOLD; ToolUniverse's iDigBio tools have no genetic barcode or BIN data.

bin_id.description: BOLD BIN identifier, e.g. 'BOLD:AAD6819' (the 'BOLD:' prefix is added automatically if omitted).

class.description: Class, e.g. 'Mammalia'. Note the property name shadows a Python keyword, so it has to be read by subscript.

collection_date_start.description: Start of the collection date, or null where the depositor gave none - measured null on the example record.

collectors.description: Who collected the specimen, e.g. 'Metro Toronto Zoo'. Also reveals a captive or zoo origin, which matters for a record used as a wild-population reference.

genus.description: Genus, e.g. 'Panthera'. Together with the ranks above this is the full lineage behind the identification, which the species name alone does not give.

identification_rank.description: How deep the identification goes, e.g. 'species', 'genus', 'family'. A record identified only to genus looks the same otherwise, so reading the name without this rank overstates what is known.

inst.description: Institution holding the voucher specimen, e.g. 'Royal Ontario Museum'. Where the physical specimen can be examined.

kingdom.description: Kingdom of the identified taxon, e.g. 'Animalia'.

marker_code.description: The barcode region sequenced, e.g. 'COI-5P', 'ITS', 'matK', 'rbcL'. Sequences from different markers are not comparable, and this is the only field that says which was used.

nuc_basecount.description: Length of the barcode sequence in bases, e.g. 643. A short COI-5P read is a weak barcode; the sequence string alone does not flag that.

sampleid.description: The depositor's own specimen id, e.g. 'ROM PM13004'. What links the record to the physical voucher in the collection.

country/ocean.description: Country or ocean the specimen came from, e.g. 'Germany'. Measured on 3 of 10 records. NOTE the '/' in the property name - it is one key, not a path.

insdc_acs.description: INSDC (GenBank/ENA/DDBJ) accession for the sequence, e.g. 'JF444381'. Measured on 9 of 10 records. The route to the sequence outside BOLD.

province/state.description: Province or state within that country, e.g. 'Bavaria'. Measured on 1 of 10. Also one key containing a '/'.

name: BOLDSystems_get_record
description: Retrieve a single BOLD (Barcode of Life Data System) DNA barcode record by its BOLD process ID. Returns full taxonomy, BIN cluster, collection metadata, and COI-5P INSDC accession. Example: process_id='ABRMM002-06' returns a Panthera leo record collected at the Metro Toronto Zoo.
